GeneDef.label: mechanite prone
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are more susceptible to mechanite infections.

GeneDef.label: pain stimulated
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene convert pain into stimulation, boosting their focus even as their bodies suffer.

GeneDef.label: clairvoyance
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are gifted with a rare psychic attunement that unlocks their perception of distant places.

GeneDef.label: hibernation
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene can enter a state of deep torpor in extreme cold, slowing the debilitating effects of hypothermia.

GeneDef.label: gauranlen descendant
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene inherit the ancient bloodline of the dryad queen, granting them the exclusive power to awaken dryad cocoons linked to their connected Gauranlen trees at will.

GeneDef.label: cheek pouch
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene develop specialised cheek pouches, allowing them to stash more food for later consumption.

GeneDef.label: nature rhythm
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a deep psychic connection to the natural world, allowing their psychic sensitivity to influence the speed at which they prune Gauranlen trees.

GeneDef.label: wind rider
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene ride the currents and find protection from the force of wild winds, though they become slow when the air is still.

GeneDef.label: route memory
GeneDef.description: Carrier remembers paths, shortcuts and safe crossings, shaving time off familiar journeys.

GeneDef.label: latent psychic
GeneDef.description: Carriers bear a hidden talent for psychic manipulation. When their traits manifest, they are very likely to become psychically sensitive and sometimes even stronger.

GeneDef.label: cud chew
GeneDef.description: Carriers chews very thoroughly and regurgitates plant matter later, gaining extra benefit from the same meal at the cost of slower eating.

GeneDef.label: motion sickness
GeneDef.description: This carrier’s inner ear cannot handle high‑speed travel. After landing from a drop pod or shuttle, they suffer short‑term sickness, making them weak and miserable for a while.

GeneDef.label: nine lives
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene hoard extra lives in their tails as they age; the older they get, the harder they are to truly kill.

GeneDef.label: phantom pain
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have altered neural structures that amplify lingering pain from lost limbs, even when the wound is long healed or replaced.

GeneDef.label: dense scar
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have scars that heal into thick, ridged tissues instead of smooth skin. These raised overgrown masses are tough to the touch and provide extra protection.

GeneDef.label: hoarder
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene are happiest when they can pile their belongings around them. They move cleanly through cluttered spaces, scattered items and furniture without slowing down.
